title: Book Two · Chapter 10: A Place in the Story
story:
On Wednesday, the train book is dry.

Miss Wu lifts it from her desk. The repaired page stays in place as she turns it.

Leo watches from his seat. Ronan watches too.

“Can it go on the shelf now?” Leo asks.

“Yes. Carry it with both hands.”

Leo brings it to the back of the room. He gives Ronan a quick look before he opens it.

“You can sit here too.”

Ronan pulls up a chair. The first page shows the station again. They remember the loose middle page, but this picture is at the start.

A boy stands beside a woman. A case is near his feet.

Ronan reads the first lines. The woman is waiting for her sister. The boy wants to go on a train.

“He is not leaving,” Ronan says.

“Not yet,” Leo says. “There is a whole book left.”

They read on. The boy sits on the case. It falls open. Clothes drop onto the ground.

Leo laughs and points.

“His seat was not ready.”

Ronan looks at the next picture. The woman is picking up a shirt. The boy still has one sock in his hand.

“He could wear it,” Leo says.

“Only one?”

“He can wait for the other.”

They find the second sock on the next page.

After lunch, Miss Wu brings a short note to their table. It has three lines. The lines explain a little classroom job.

Ronan reads them all first. He puts a clean card on the shelf. Then he places the checked books beside it. The note says to leave a small space at the end. He keeps that space clear.

Miss Wu walks past and stops.

“Ready?”

“Yes.”

She checks the space and the card. “Thank you.”

Ronan feels pleased. There is no wrong object to move this time. He takes the note back to her desk.

Miss Wu has four small sheets beside her books. Each sheet has a short story.

“Can you two help on Friday?” she asks.

Leo answers yes at once.

Ronan looks at the writing. It is not much longer than the train page.

“What will we do?”

“Read in a small group. Then talk about the story.”

“Both of us?”

“Both of you. Tomorrow we can look at the pages.”

Ronan agrees. On the way to his seat, he looks at Leo.

“I can read the first part.”

“Perhaps I can.”

They both stop beside the shelf.

“Miss Wu did not choose yet,” Leo says.

Ronan nods. He gives Leo room to take his bag.

After school, he tells Dad about Friday. Dad is putting away his work shoes.

“Which story?”

“I do not know yet.”

“You will see the story tomorrow. Tell me about it then.”

Ronan reaches into his bag. His own picture book is inside. The train book is still at school. He takes out his picture book and puts it on the table.

He opens to the page after the bridge. This time, he begins at the first line.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

check＝检查；group＝小组；choose＝选择；agree＝同意。

## 理解问题

1. 两人读故事后，怎样重新理解那个男孩是否要乘火车？
2. 周五的任务目前确定了什么、还没确定什么？

## 读句子

The repaired page / stays in place / as she turns it.＝修好的书页／留在原位／当她翻动书页时。
